name: Cold Turkey Bill
role: Stage-line hand at North Grand station
bio: "Cold Turkey Bill" came into Medora from the North Grand stage station in March 1885 and was teased by the paper for dressing up. By March 1886 he was reported in Billings, Montana.

moments.label: Came in from North Grand stage station

mentions: "Cold Turkey Bill" came in from North Grand stage station, Wednesday, has been posing as a dude since and will start back to his station soon.
If any one wants a muss on their hands (right smart,) just ask Mr. Turkey Bill if he is from Chicago. Take off that dude collar Bill so that your friends will know you.
Jack Matlock and Charlie Jolly are driving on the Billings & Benton stage line and "Cold Turkey" Bill is in Billings.
